scope: quality projection, stable-Part change prepare, approval/version/restore and CAS-backed MVP GLB export

mcp009_test.evidence: 24 Runtime library tests, 16 MCP adapter tests, contract check and development binaries passed.

release_mvp_aggregate.evidence: Unified MVP functional-core release command passed on 2026-08-09, including docs/integrity/safety/license, MCP005–009, desktop build and offline Tauri check.

runtime_golden_path.evidence: Appearance candidate was prepared, confirmed once, diffed, and exported as a GLB receipt; a stable-Part change was prepared against the confirmed head and remained reviewable without creating a version.

reject_restore_regression.evidence: Existing Runtime tests cover idempotent reject, immutable confirm, restore-as-new-version and diagnostic export regression.

real_codex_full_golden_path.reason: A clean Codex CLI run with the authorized image attachment completed the exact twelve-call reference → geometry → appearance → quality → confirm → version → CAS-backed MVP GLB export sequence. Earlier blocked attempts remain historical and are not used as the PASS receipt.

reference_similarity.evidence: quality_get supports an explicitly limited aspect-ratio comparison only; pixel silhouette/landmark/region inference from one image remains unimplemented.

human_visual_acceptance.reason: No user visual score or independent human gate was recorded.

packaged_export.reason: Developer ID/notarization and packaged Desktop/CLI E2E belong to MCP013.

transaction_evidence.permanent_writes: prepare/change_prepare never create versions; confirm creates one immutable child after Runtime rechecks candidate hash, quality and idempotency.
transaction_evidence.change_prepare: Requires base_version_id, one allowlisted operation (transform/material_update/replace_geometry), a stable Part ID present in the new typed GeometryProgram, and bounded parameters.
transaction_evidence.export: mvp-glb is restricted to a confirmed quality-passing version whose CAS object is a Runtime GLB; confirm returns output_sha256 and a hash-bound receipt. Filesystem export targets are deliberately deferred.

mvp_claim_boundary: The single-user reference-to-CAS-GLB host golden path is complete for this bounded hard-surface robot MVP. Do not claim pixel-level similarity, independent human visual acceptance, filesystem/package export, signing or general image-to-3D coverage.
